ease.name: Ease (%)
ease.help: This controls the amount of ease. Since this is a pattern for leggings that is normally made of stretch fabric, the ease is negative, meaning the fabric is stretched around the body.

waistband.name: Waistband
waistband.help: Add a separate waistband to the design

backgusset.name: Back Gusset
backgusset.help: Add a circular gusset in the back

cyclingchamois.name: Cycling Chamois
cyclingchamois.help: Allow for a chamois to be added. This sets some of the percentages, and automatically enables certain features

frontbulge.name: Front bulge
frontbulge.help: Add a bulge in the front

leglength.name: Leg length (%)
leglength.help: The length of the legs. A percentage of the inseam measurement.

waistlowering.name: Waist lowering (%)
waistlowering.help: Lowering of the waist. This is a percentage of the Waist-To-Hips measurement.

gussetwidth.name: Gusset width (%)
gussetwidth.help: Width of the gusset. This is a percentage of the front cross seam.

frontgussetlength.name: Front gusset length (%)
frontgussetlength.help: This configures how far the gusset should extend in the front. This is a percentage of the front cross seam.

waistbandsize.name: Waistband size (%)
waistbandsize.help: Size (height) of the waistband. This is a percentage of the Waist-To-Hips measurement.

waistreduction.name: Waist circumference reduction (%)
waistreduction.help: The amount by which the waist should be reduced. This is a percentage of the waist circumference. Only available when the waistband option is selected.

backgussetwidth.name: Back Gusset width (%)
backgussetwidth.help: The width of the gusset in the back. This is a percentage of the hips circumference.

buttlift.name: Butt lift (%)
buttlift.help: This setting controls the shape of the back gusset, thereby creating more or less support to lift the buttocks

frontbulgesize.name: Front bulge size (%)
frontbulgesize.help: The size of the front bulge. This is a percentage of the front cross seam. (Take it easy, you need less than you think, big boy)
